newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Jefferson County, Ky..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Jefferson County, Ky..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS for the purchase of $18,500,000 principal amount of the County of Jefferson, Kentucky Governmental Project Lease Revenue Bonds, Series 1997 (University of Louisville Cardinal Stadium Project), dated March 1, 1997, will be received by the County of Jefferson, Kentucky (the Issuer''), in the Office of the Chief Financial Officer of the Issuer, at 517 Court Place, Suite 501, Louisville, Kentucky 40202, until 11:00 A.M. EST (local time) on

at which time and place they will be publicly opened and announced, for the purchase at a price of not less than 98.5% of the principal amount thereof and accrued interest, of such Bonds. The Issuer reserves the right to adjust the principal amounts of the individual maturities of the Bonds as provided in the Official Terms and Conditions of Bond Sale, in order to achieve level debt service and the lowest interest cost on the Bonds, but the Bonds will be issued in the full principal amount of $18,500,000.

AMBAC Indemnity Corporation (AMBACIndemnity'') has issued a commitment for municipal bond insurance relating to the Bonds. All bids may be conditioned upon the issuance effective as of the date on which the bonds are issued, of a policy of insurance by AMBAC Indemnity, insuring the payment when due of principal of and interest on the Bonds. Each Bond will bear a legend referring to the insurance. The purchaser, holder or owner is not authorized to make any statements concerning the insurance beyond those set out here and in the bond legend without the approval of AMBACIndemnity.

Copies of the official Terms and Conditions of Bond Sale and the Official Bid Form, containing detailed information concerning the terms of the sale of the Bonds, including offering terms, information concerning bidding procedures and related matters, together with the Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Bonds, may be obtained from either Financial Advisor, J.J.B. Hilliard, W.L. Lyons, Inc.,
Hilliard Lyons Center, 501 South Fourth Avenue, Louisville, Kentucky 40202 (502-588-8400), or Jackson Securities,
